summary: Layer 1B expanded the direct public-company universe around the consumer-facing electrical infrastructure stack. The strongest mapped exposures are not consumer brands, but electrical distributors, switchgear makers, conduit/cable-management suppliers, and specialty electrical contractors that could benefit when retailers, warehouses, cold-chain operators, hotels, restaurants, and fulfillment sites require higher power density, EV charging, automation, refrigeration, controls, and grid tie-ins.
